01 · PROFILE

Build log

A compact view of the engineer behind the projects. The portfolio focuses on what was built, how the systems work, and the engineering decisions behind them.

Final-year Computer Science & Engineering student at North South University, graduating September 2026. Focused on AI and Generative AI applications in Python, with hands-on work across RAG, local LLMs, embeddings, vector search, deep learning, REST backends and databases.

The strongest part of the portfolio is the ability to move from an idea to an end-to-end system: ingest data, process it, run inference, expose it through an interface/API, evaluate it, and think about deployment cost and reliability.
